scope: Only dtype=float16, product of leading dimensions=1, D=64 may select a new implementation. All other source and methods remain the exact H6SHARE baseline.
objective: Improve case1 duration; do not select by total score or combine independent per-case minima.
known_case1_scene: Historical official tests identify the FP16 single-row D64 entry; exact leading singleton dimensions and input distribution are not assumed.

cloud.correctness: Shared baseline for eight seed/pattern inputs. Preserve both strict outcomes and bitwise equality; reject any new strict failure on a baseline-passing input.
cloud.screening: Serial msprof device task durations, warmup=10, repeats=1, batch=20, median of last 20 of 31 tasks. Shared baseline controls across a candidate batch.
cloud.confirmation: Repeat promising candidate and baseline in alternating order; retain all task durations. Cloud results do not establish official gains.

official: Submit complete isolated candidates when the logged-in evaluation session is available. Preserve all 15 point outcomes, emphasize case1, and keep H6SHARE source separately for restoration.
probe_policy: Only if metadata uncertainty prevents optimization; preserve outputs, label diagnostic timings, never use test numbers or prior computed answers in final kernels.
merge: No merge into the retained root baseline during this focused investigation.
